topics.name: Asymptotic Analysis and Recurrences
topics.description: Big-O, Omega, Theta notations, Master Theorem for divide-and-conquer recurrences, recursion tree method, substitution method.

topics.name: Searching, Sorting and Hashing
topics.description: Linear and binary search, comparison sort bounds, Quick Sort, Merge Sort, Heap Sort, Counting Sort, open addressing and chaining hashing collision resolution.

topics.name: Divide and Conquer Technique
topics.description: Merge sort, quick sort partitioning, counting inversions, Strassen matrix multiplication, finding median and order statistics.

topics.name: Greedy Algorithm Design
topics.description: Greedy-choice property, optimal substructure, Fractional Knapsack, Activity Selection, Huffman Coding prefix codes, optimal merge patterns.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Overlapping subproblems, 0/1 Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence (LCS), Matrix Chain Multiplication, Subset Sum, Bellman equation.

topics.name: Graph Algorithms: MST and Shortest Paths
topics.description: Dijkstra's single-source shortest path, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall all-pairs, Prim's and Kruskal's Minimum Spanning Tree algorithms, topological sorting.

topics.name: Lexical Analysis
topics.description: Role of lexical analyzer, tokens, patterns, lexemes, regular definitions, transition diagrams, recognition of tokens, lookahead buffer.

topics.name: Parsing: LL(1), LR(0), SLR, LALR and CLR
topics.description: Top-down parsing (LL(1), FIRST and FOLLOW sets), bottom-up parsing (shift-reduce, LR(0), SLR(1), LALR(1), CLR(1) item sets and parsing tables), operator precedence.

topics.name: Syntax-Directed Translation and Intermediate Code
topics.description: Syntax-Directed Definitions (SDD), synthesized and inherited attributes, S-attributed and L-attributed definitions, three-address code (quadruples, triples), runtime storage organization and activation records.

topics.name: Code Optimization and Data Flow Analysis
topics.description: Basic blocks and flow graphs, local optimization (DAG representation, common subexpression elimination, dead code elimination), data flow analyses (constant propagation, liveness analysis, reaching definitions).

topics.name: System Calls, Processes, Threads and IPC
topics.description: System calls, process states, fork() execution trees, user vs kernel threads, Inter-Process Communication (shared memory, message passing, pipes).

topics.name: CPU and I/O Scheduling
topics.description: Preemptive and non-preemptive scheduling, FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin, Priority, Multi-level queue scheduling, turnaround time, waiting time, Gantt charts.

topics.name: Concurrency and Process Synchronization
topics.description: Critical section problem, Peterson's algorithm, TestAndSet atomic hardware instructions, Counting and Binary Semaphores, Mutex locks, classical problems (Producer-Consumer, Readers-Writers).

topics.name: Deadlock Characterization and Banker's Algorithm
topics.description: Coffman four conditions, Resource Allocation Graphs, Banker's Safety Algorithm for avoidance, prevention vs avoidance vs detection and recovery.

topics.name: Memory Management and Virtual Memory
topics.description: Paging, segmentation, Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB), effective memory access time, demand paging, page fault handling, Belady's anomaly in FIFO, Optimal and LRU page replacement.

topics.name: File Systems and Disk Scheduling
topics.description: File allocation methods, UNIX inode indexing, disk seek time, disk scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, C-LOOK).

topics.name: ER Model, Relational Model and Constraints
topics.description: Entity-Relationship diagrams, weak entities, mapping ER to relational schemas, super, candidate, primary and foreign keys, integrity constraints.

topics.name: Relational Algebra, Tuple Calculus and SQL
topics.description: Relational algebra operators (Select, Project, Join variants, Set operations), Tuple Relational Calculus, complex SQL queries, nested subqueries, aggregations, GROUP BY and HAVING.

topics.name: Functional Dependencies and Normal Forms
topics.description: Closure of attributes, minimal covers, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, lossless join decomposition condition, dependency preservation.

topics.name: File Organization and B/B+ Tree Indexing
topics.description: Primary, secondary, clustering indexing, dense vs sparse indexes, B-Trees and B+ Trees node capacity, insertion, deletion, height and block access calculations.

topics.name: Transactions and Concurrency Control
topics.description: ACID properties, conflict and view serializability, precedence graphs, Two-Phase Locking (2PL, Strict 2PL, Rigorous 2PL), timestamp ordering, recoverability and cascading rollbacks.

topics.name: Principles of Layering, Switching and Metrics
topics.description: OSI and TCP/IP protocol stack, circuit switching vs packet switching vs virtual circuit, propagation delay, transmission delay, bandwidth-delay product.

topics.name: Data Link Layer, MAC and Ethernet
topics.description: Framing, error detection (CRC, checksum, parity), flow control (Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat efficiency), CSMA/CD, minimum frame size in Ethernet.

topics.name: Routing Algorithms: Distance Vector and Link State
topics.description: Distance Vector Routing (Bellman-Ford, Count-to-Infinity problem), Link State Routing (Dijkstra's algorithm), RIP, OSPF, BGP concepts.

topics.name: IPv4 Header, Fragmentation, CIDR and NAT
topics.description: IPv4 datagram header fields, packet fragmentation offset calculations, classless addressing (CIDR subnetting, supernetting, longest prefix match), Network Address Translation (NAT).

topics.name: TCP Flow Control, Congestion Control and Sockets
topics.description: TCP segment structure, 3-way handshake, sliding window flow control, congestion control (Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, Fast Recovery, AIMD, timeout calculations), socket API.

topics.name: Application Layer Protocols: DNS and HTTP
topics.description: Domain Name System (DNS iterative vs recursive resolution, record types), HTTP (persistent vs non-persistent connections, HTTP methods, response codes, caching).
